title: Not the real thing
text:
Not the real thing. Been using Nag Champa for years. This is not same quality.
Horrible smoke. Sticks crumble all over everything. Should have asked for a refund
When I had chance.

product_metadata.title: Satya Sai Baba Nag Champa Agarbatti Incense Sticks Box 250gms Hand Rolled Agarbatti Fine Quality Incense Sticks for Purification, Relaxation, Positivity, Yoga, Meditation
features: Original Handrolled Satya Sai Baba Nagchampa Agarbatti manufactured in Bangalore and Mumbai by Shrinivas Sugandhalaya LLP
The Preparation consists of formulation of masala mix using natural extracts in the form of dough concerning the ancient method and is rolled by hand on the bamboo sticks.
Satya Sai Baba Nagchampa is a combination of Champa flower, floral, Oriental-Spicy aroma with a base note of wood and patchouli. It is a reminiscent of Jasmine or magnolia flowers.
The aroma that emits from this agarbatti creates a soothing and calm environment
